title: Pellencin 2018 · validation of social visual–tactile PPS
citation: Pellencin, E., Paladino, M. P., Herbelin, B., & Serino, A. (2018). Social perception of others shapes one's own multisensory peripersonal space. Cortex, 104, 163–179.
notes: Published study settings are available for inspection. See the source-backed method and remaining execution requirements.

published_method.visual: Following a 300 ms fixation cross and 700 ms of scene alone, a brown virtual cube with 20 cm edges approaches the face at 0.75 m/s for 2600 ms, then stays still for 400 ms.

timing.anchor: Virtual cube onset or matched time in a no-cube trial

published_method.tactile: Clearly felt 350 ms vibration from a stimulator held in the left hand; detect it with the right-hand mouse button.
published_method.baseline: Use each participant’s quickest mean tactile-only RT among the six matched delays.
published_method.context: Prerecorded corridor with an actress; reconcile the summary’s seated posture with the detailed standing procedure.

stimulus_type.value: Visual approaching object with tactile stimulation
stimulus_type.source: Pellencin et al. 2018, Elsevier preview, Introduction

source_provenance.value: Virtual object rendered in a prerecorded real corridor scene.
source_provenance.source: Pellencin et al. 2018, Elsevier preview, Introduction; Pellencin et al. 2018, Elsevier preview, Experiment 1: the social visuo-tactile interaction task
source_provenance.gap: Original videos, meshes, scene calibration and executable task unavailable.

implementation_gaps: The original RealiSM stereoscopic scenes, body alignment and exact cube metrics in participant coordinates are unavailable.
The virtual-scene scheduler must synchronize the fixation, prerecorded corridor, cube and physical left-hand vibrotactile events with a calibrated reaction-time response route.
reference_parameters.planner_scope: The study settings describe the source procedure. The Planner contains no executable trial schedule for this profile.
